items.title: Ingram Micro jumps after securing spot in S&P SmallCap 600
items.summary: Investing.com -- Ingram Micro Holding Ltd (NYSE:INGM) shares climbed 4.8% in extended trading Wednesday after S&P Dow Jones Indices announced the technology distributor will join the S&P SmallCap 600. The Irvine, California-based company is scheduled to enter the benchmark prior to the open of trading on Tuesday, November 17, replacing Pacira Pharmaceuticals Inc (NASDAQ:PCRX).

items.title: David Einhorn’s Best Buy Is Already Up 36%. Is It Too Late to Follow Him?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPayPal is up 36% since June 30, the best of the seven stocks David Einhorn’s Greenlight Capital bought or added to in the second quarter. Even after that run, PayPal trades at 10x forward earnings, well below its five-year average, so it isn’t too late to follow him.

items.title: VTRS Q3 2026 deep dive: new product launches and Pacira acquisition shape outlook
items.summary: Medication company Viatris (NASDAQ:VTRS) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales flat year on year at $3.75 billion. On the other hand, the company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $14.8 billion at the midpoint. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.71 per share was 11.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
